poz_005: You can recognise it by its thick trunk, 411 centimetres round. It stands in the Dziedziniec Rozany, the Rose Courtyard, between the Zamek castle and the Arsenal building.
poz_006: You can recognise it by its deeply lobed leaves, undersides almost white, flashing pale in a gust of wind. It stands on the Skwer Zielone Ogrodki, where ul. Zielona meets ul. Strzelecka.
poz_007: You can recognise it by its tall, regular crown rising to 30 metres. It stands in the western section of Cytadela Park, near ul. Za Cytadela.
poz_008: You can recognise it by its trunk, splitting partway up into three separate crowns from one thick base. It stands near the Garrison Cemetery, at the corner of ul. Armii Poznan and ul. Za Cytadela.
poz_009: You can recognise it by its very thick trunk, 484 centimetres round. It stands in Park Wilsona, opposite the tram stop, near the Palmiarnia palm house.
poz_010: You can recognise it by its thick trunk, 375 centimetres round, standing inside a fenced municipal playground. It stands at the corner of ul. Pradzynskiego and ul. Garczynskiego in Wilda.
